subject: Request: Authorization to use Solara brand elements in Redwood case study
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace Li <grace.li@solara.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Authorization to use Solara brand elements in Redwood case study

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the great session last week. We put together a short draft case study that highlights the latency and cost improvements you saw running the fin-recon pipeline on Redwood. Would Solara be comfortable with us publishing a one-page case study on our public site and marketing channels that includes:

- Solara logo (full color + reversed)
- A short pull-quote attributed to "Grace Li, Head of Data Platform"
- A product screenshot (anonymized; no PII)

We want to run this by your marketing and legal teams for brand and copy approval first. If you’re fine in principle, could you share any brand requirements or a preferred logo package? We can also send a simple release agreement if helpful.

Attached: draft-case-study-v1.pdf (for internal preview)

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.inference.com
[Attachment: draft-case-study-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Grace Li <grace.li@solara.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Hart <marcus.hart@solara.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Authorization to use Solara brand elements in Redwood case study

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for sending this over — congrats to the team on the numbers. Solara is happy to be featured, subject to a few standard conditions from our marketing/legal side:

1) Use the official logos only (we'll attach the package)
2) Any quote attributed to a Solara employee needs a brief approval window (48 hours)
3) Screenshots must have customer-identifying details redacted (we can sign off once we confirm)
4) We prefer a single shared PDF with final signoff and a simple one-paragraph release rather than DocuSign for small use cases; however, our legal is okay with DocuSign if that’s easier for you.

Attaching our brand guidelines and a zip with EPS/SVG/PNG variants. Please send the final copy back for approval — Marcus on legal is copied.

Best,
Grace Li
Head of Marketing, Solara Analytics
grace.li@solara.io
[Attachment: Solara_Brand_Guidelines_2026.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: solara_logo_eps.zip (application/zip)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Authorization to use Solara brand elements in Redwood case study

Vivek/Stephanie —

Thanks for the heads up and attaching the draft. I reviewed Solara's brand guidelines quickly. A few notes from comms/legal perspective before we send a final back to them:

- We should provide (a) web-optimized PNG and (b) EPS for print. Use only the provided assets — no color/clearspace changes.
- On the quote: we’ll add a one-line sentence to the draft that Grace can approve. We should add: "Approved for publication pending Solara sign-off on the exact quote and final screenshot."
- Add an explicit copyright line and a 12-month review clause: "Solara may request removal or update with 30 days' notice."
- If Marcus from Solara wants DocuSign we can do that; for speed I recommend a signed PDF emailed back.

I’ll prepare the copy edits and include the legal blurb. Vivek — do you want me to send the updated PDF to Grace, or do you want to keep hunting down the quote first?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Communications Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.inference.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Grace Li <grace.li@solara.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Hart <marcus.hart@solara.io>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Authorization to use Solara brand elements in Redwood case study

Hi Grace / Marcus —

Thanks for the files. Vanessa has a couple small copy and legal notes which I’ve incorporated into the attached updated PDF (short, marked changes). We left the quote area as a placeholder so you can provide the exact language you want attributed.

Attached: solara-case-draft-v2.pdf (includes legal blurb and 12-month review clause)

Two quick asks to move forward this week:
1) Please confirm the preferred short quote (48-hour approval window).
2) Confirm you’re happy with the EPS/PNG assets you sent; if not, attach the preferred variant.

If Marcus prefers DocuSign for the release, happy to complete that — we can also accept a signed PDF by email.

Appreciate your help — we’d love to publish the spotlight the week of Sep 27.

Best,
Vivek
[Attachment: solara-case-draft-v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marcus Hart <marcus.hart@solara.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>, Grace Li <grace.li@solara.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Authorization to use Solara brand elements in Redwood case study

Vivek / Vanessa —

Looks good from our side; we reviewed the updated PDF and approve use with the following final minor edits (applied directly to the attached PDF):

- Final quote: "Redwood’s platform reduced our batch inference latency by ~45% while lowering per-token cost." — Grace Li
- Please anonymize the customer-id in screenshot #2 (we left a redacted version in the file)
- Add the line "Use of Solara trademarks subject to Solara Analytics' brand guidelines (attached)."

We’re attaching the redacted screenshot and a signed PDF release for your records. No DocuSign required. You have our permission to publish across your website, social, and newsletter channels.

Cheers,
Marcus Hart
Senior Counsel, Solara Analytics
[Attachment: solara-signed-release-sep18.pdf (application/pdf)]
